newsitem.title: EGYPT: Next stage in Eastern privatisation soon.
newsitem.headline: Next stage in Eastern privatisation soon.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Holding Company for Mining and Refractories said on Thursday it was about to offer between 10 and 20 percent of monopoly cigarette manufacturer Eastern Company for sale to big investors.
It said it would auction between 2.5 million and five million of the 25 million shares in the partially privatised company. It said it would give full details soon.

Earlier this month Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid was quoted as saying the state would give up majority control of the company. But in an interview published on Wednesday the minister said it was one of the companies in which the state would retain a majority stake when its privatisation programme ends.
The state sold 10 percent of Eastern Company to the private sector in June 1995.
